title: Enforce supplier invoice evidence authorization independently of request path
description: Stage3 critical authority path repair. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/PurchaseInvoiceController.cs:102-111 returns false for absent request context/path and identity, so supplier invoice evidence routes can execute without live identity/menu/scope. Remove the request-shape bypass and require the existing authoritative supplier-invoice menu/customer scope on every paged/detail/reconciliation/create/update/record/void/allocation operation; preserve original shared invoice/payment capacity transaction locks and all currency/amount semantics. Preserve existing ERP business permissions, data scopes, transactions and numeric validation. Adapt legacy controller fixtures to genuine enabled identities and their existing menu grants in isolated test data only. No Request.Path/environment/blank-context/test-only switch, anonymous fallback, permission expansion, production access or schema change. Genuine SQL uses exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database, refusing existing or wrong targets before access; never drop/reset. Preserve full failing logs. Safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors and full unit suite, plus new authenticated real SQL tests are required; build is not whole phase acceptance.
